Return a list of output lines, rather than printing them. Preserve leading spaces and use no trailing spaces. n >= 0. Use row sizes 1..n followed by n-1..1. A size-i row has n-i leading spaces and 2*i-1 stars. n=0 returns [].

Call solve with the positional arguments shown in each test. Return the result; do not print.

Example

{
  "args": [
    3
  ],
  "expected": [
    "  *",
    " ***",
    "*****",
    " ***",
    "  *"
  ]
}

Example

{
  "args": [
    1
  ],
  "expected": [
    "*"
  ]
}
Hint

Use the widest row exactly once.

Complexity: O(n^2) characters of time and output
